Troubleshooting

Macle allows users to print exception logs during the use of the development tool, helping developers efficiently and accurately locate exceptions. (Minimum Version: 23.9.0.)

Function Entry

Viewing Logs

After the log printing function is enabled on the extended configuration item page of the development tool, if an error occurs during the tool running, error logs are generated in the following path:

User/User name/.macle/log/log.txt
